summary: Bare mill-finish titanium, a warm darker grey than steel with a soft hazy sheen, as on aerospace parts, cookware and architectural cladding.
_comment: Raw titanium: mill-finish titanium sheet, plate or bar as it leaves the rolls, with no polishing, brushing or anodising: a warm, slightly brownish mid-to-light grey, darker than aluminium or steel, with a soft hazy reflection (cladding, aerospace and marine parts, cookware, watch cases before finishing). Opaque, param-only: a solid metal with no texture of its own at this scale; the finish is the roughness. Base colour is the Physically Based Titanium entry. APPROXIMATE: OpenPBR's metal edge tint (specular_color, the F82 tint) and the complex IOR are not carried by the library (F-LC-6). Carries every relevant wear layer at 0 (C1): hairline scratches (overlay 1, damage), dust as a deposit (Phase10), fingerprints, gated by the Edges mask (its B channel is the broad corner band meant for a deposit, its A the open faces meant for handling marks, so dust takes slot 2 and fingerprints slot 3). Not carried: the tarnish (oxide interference) colour the wish list also wants.
name: Titanium_Raw_Clean_Base_s01_v01
